spec.note: Blocked-copying counterpart of legacy_eval_supply.json: identical evaluations, grid, shelves and refinement rule; each funded account copies a signal only while flat. The unlimited-supply winners come from the blocked reserve comparison and must reproduce, including per-trade account assignments. Evaluations do not depend on funded-account copying, so the EODMAE reconciliation must equal the non-blocking one. Settings shared with the 25K blocked-pipeline study must reproduce it exactly.

legacy_25k.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.
